user_text: Perfect, that's done. Wow, it's really late.
text:
Ha, well according to my clock it's 2 PM on a Thursday, so you've got plenty of daylight left! But if it's late where you are, you put in solid work here. You covered a lot of ground: relative vs. parallel minor, all three minor scale forms, accidentals, and left-hand voicings.

When you get to the piano, start with the A natural minor version since it uses your original pitches and just reframes the tonal center. That'll make the concept click immediately. Then layer in the G# for harmonic and the F# for melodic, and you'll hear exactly why those raised degrees exist.

Have fun with it, and feel free to come back when you want to develop the motif further or start harmonizing it more fully!
